slideToCompareImages: Simbiriirixi si aad u barbardhigto sawirada
wipeHelpLead: U bar bar dhig labada sawir adigoo adeegsanaya kala-qaybiyaha.
wipeHelpPointer: Jiid gacan-qabadka wareegsan, ama guji meel kasta oo sawirka ah si aad kala-qaybiyaha ugu dhaqaajiso halkaas.
fadeHelpLead: Si tartiib ah ugu beddel labada sawir dhexdooda.
fadeHelpPointer: Jiid sliderka hoosta sawirka ku yaal, ama guji barta ku taal.
